title: Facebook Groups for Local Business: Building a Community

facts.fact: Buffer reports that over 1.8 billion people actively use Facebook Groups each month (third-party claim cited by AdWave).
facts.quote: Over 1.8 billion people actively use Facebook Groups each month

facts.fact: AdWave's article is published with a timestamp of April 15, 2026.
Performance Financial is cited as the source for a naming pattern that uses local keyword framing such as "[Your City] Homeowners" (third-party guidance, not a number).
facts.quote: The most useful starting point is local keyword framing such as **"[Your City] Homeowners"** or related community phrases

facts.fact: The page recommends that most local businesses set a Facebook group to "private but visible" as the best privacy setting (AdWave's own recommendation, no numeric value).
facts.quote: For most local businesses, **private but visible** is the sweet spot.
